content_html:
TokenTV

Turn a ~$5 AliExpress clock (GeekMagic SmallTV) into pixel pets for Claude Code and Codex. They react to your agents and keep your usage limits in sight. No firmware flashing.

See every scene: the collection, a few still sealed.
Try it: live demo or npx token-tv demo, no clock or login needed.
Set it up: npx token-tv start (or uvx token-tv start) on a computer that stays on. It finds the clock on your Wi-Fi and your signed-in tools. Or tell your AI "Set up TokenTV for me" (AGENTS.md).

Claude Code mode: Clawd raises a hand when Claude needs you, holds court over risky commands and sulks when you shout (set it up).
Arcade: the bots get busy while you code. Codex rains code on its garden, Grok fuels its rocket, and Copilot and Anti join in.

Secret scenes: some only at certain hours, some almost never.

Cuteness is a feature. Ideas and PRs welcome.
More: video · TokenTV in the wild · which clock to buy
